assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate the patient's recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness with underlying arrhythmias
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The service is medically necessary to optimize rate control management for these symptomatic events
The clinical necessity remains unaffected by the coordination of benefits determination under reason code CO-22
Reason code CO-22 addresses secondary payer liability rather than the medical necessity of the service
